Arcane.name: Wand Specialization
Arcane.description: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

Arcane.name: Arcane Focus
Arcane.description: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by 5%.

Arcane.name: Improved Channeling
Arcane.description: Gives you a 100% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 70% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

Arcane.name: Arcane Subtlety
Arcane.description: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

Arcane.name: Magic Absorption
Arcane.description: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

Arcane.name: Arcane Concentration
Arcane.description: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

Arcane.name: Arcane Resilience
Arcane.description: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

Arcane.name: Arcane Geometry
Arcane.description: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

Arcane.name: Arcane Impact
Arcane.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

Arcane.name: Arcane Blast
Arcane.description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing <!--ppl20:28:54:90-->57 to 65 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

Arcane.name: Arcane Shielding
Arcane.description: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

Arcane.name: Improved Counterspell
Arcane.description: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

Arcane.name: Arcane Meditation
Arcane.description: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Arcane.name: Missile Barrage
Arcane.description: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

Arcane.name: Presence of Mind
Arcane.description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Arcane.name: Arcane Mind
Arcane.description: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

Arcane.name: Arcane Instability
Arcane.description: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

Arcane.name: Arcane Power
Arcane.description: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

Fire.name: Wake of Fire
Fire.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 30 sec by 50%.

Fire.name: Incineration
Fire.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 6%.

Fire.name: Improved Fireball
Fire.description: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by 0.5 sec.

Fire.name: Ignite
Fire.description: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

Fire.name: Flame Throwing
Fire.description: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

Fire.name: Impact
Fire.description: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

Fire.name: Burning Soul
Fire.description: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

Fire.name: Improved Flamestrike
Fire.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

Fire.name: Pyroblast
Fire.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes <!--ppl20:24:110:150-->101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Fire.name: Improved Scorch
Fire.description: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Fire.name: Improved Fire Ward
Fire.description: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

Fire.name: Hot Streak
Fire.description: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 20 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

Fire.name: Master of Elements
Fire.description: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

Fire.name: Critical Mass
Fire.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

Fire.name: Blast Wave
Fire.description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for <!--ppl30:36:163:100-->154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

Fire.name: Fire Power
Fire.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 10%.

Fire.name: Combustion
Fire.description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

Frost.name: Frost Warding
Frost.description: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

Frost.name: Improved Frostbolt
Frost.description: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

Frost.name: Elemental Precision
Frost.description: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 5%.

Frost.name: Ice Shards
Frost.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

Frost.name: Permafrost
Frost.description: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

Frost.name: Improved Frost Nova
Frost.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

Frost.name: Frostbite
Frost.description: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

Frost.name: Piercing Ice
Frost.description: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 6%.

Frost.name: Frost Channeling
Frost.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

Frost.name: Ice Lance
Frost.description: Deals <!--ppl20:26:28:35-->28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

Frost.name: Improved Blizzard
Frost.description: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

Frost.name: Arctic Reach
Frost.description: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

Frost.name: Ice Block
Frost.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Frost.name: Shatter
Frost.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

Frost.name: Improved Cone of Cold
Frost.description: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

Frost.name: Cold Snap
Frost.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

Frost.name: Fingers of Frost
Frost.description: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 <!--singular:spell:spells-->spells<!--singular--> cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

Frost.name: Winter's Chill
Frost.description: Gives your Frost damage spells a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

Frost.name: Ice Barrier
Frost.description: Instantly shields you, absorbing <!--ppl40:46:431:280-->448 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
